security.access_control: SCA required for digital SAR submission. Postal submissions require document identity verification by compliance team.
security.audit: SAR receipt timestamp logged immutably — 30-day clock evidence

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — batch process; SLA is days not seconds

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — comprehensive personal data across all bank systems
security.access_control: Data extraction restricted to authorised compliance system service account. No human direct database access.
security.audit: List of data sources queried and record counts logged for each extraction

latency.review_sla: Target < 10 working days for standard cases

per_phase_nfrs.availability: Internal process — no system availability SLA

security.access_control: DPO team members only. Response pack encrypted at rest. Redaction log maintained separately.
security.audit: All redaction decisions logged with Schedule 2 exemption category applied

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — response delivery is a regulatory obligation

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — customer's comprehensive personal data
security.access_control: Secure one-time download link expires after 14 days. Link scoped to verified customer identity only.
security.audit: Response dispatch timestamp and delivery confirmation logged (ICO audit evidence)

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: SAR Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: SarCase records (including redaction logs, response pack references) retained for minimum 3 years after case closure. Response packs retained for 3 years per ICO guidance.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: ICO enforcement window; potential court proceedings relating to data subject rights.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: 30-Day Deadline Monitoring
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Automated alert system must warn compliance team at day 21 (70% of deadline) and day 28 (93% of deadline) for any open SarCase not yet in response_ready status.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: UK GDPR Article 12(3) 30-day hard deadline. ICO issues enforcement notices and fines for repeated deadline failures.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Data Minimisation in Response Pack
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Response pack must contain only personal data of the subject. Third-party personal data must be redacted or withheld. Fraud investigation data protected under Schedule 2 Part 1 exemption may be withheld.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: UK GDPR Article 15 right of access is not absolute — exemptions must be applied correctly to avoid disclosing third-party data.

regulatory_slas.name: UK GDPR Article 12(3) — 30-Day Response Deadline
regulatory_slas.requirement: Bank must respond to a SAR within 30 calendar days of receipt. May extend by a further 2 months for complex/numerous requests with notification within 30 days.
regulatory_slas.source: UK GDPR Article 12(3), UK Data Protection Act 2018
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: ICO enforcement notice; fine up to £17.5 million or 4% of global turnover (whichever higher)

regulatory_slas.name: UK GDPR Article 15 — Right of Access
regulatory_slas.requirement: Bank must provide a copy of all personal data held about the individual, processing purposes, recipients, retention periods, and information on other data subject rights.
regulatory_slas.source: UK GDPR Article 15, UK Data Protection Act 2018
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: ICO enforcement; reputational damage; subject may refer to ICO or courts
